compiled_state.title: [test-test-batched]: test_interrupted_node_test_reruns_on_resume fails on CI -> PR script-tests blocked while passing locally
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
Flaky test discovered in PR #93 (alias backfill).

**Symptom**: `test_interrupted_node_test_reruns_on_resume: state records interrupted result` fails on CI when running the full script-tests batch.

**Reproduction**:
- Local single-file: passes.
- CI on PR #93 rerun (run 25707344247 retried, job 75481134774): 83/84 with this one failing.
- A separate CI run on the SAME PR head failed on a different flaky test (test_version_bump_marks_state_complete), then passed it on rerun — different test fails each pass, classic flakiness.

**Likely root cause**: parallel-test interference. The interrupted-node-test scenario depends on a temp state file; if a sibling test in the same worker writes to an overlapping path the state record loses race.
